summary: When the state byte at this+0x117 is below 8, OR bit 4 (value 4) into the flags DWORD at this+0x60 and write 8 to the driver-state byte at this+0x118. Always returns the input a1. Conditionally elevates driver state once the byte at 0x117 has not yet reached 8.

operations.description: result = a1: capture the object/context pointer for the return value.
Guard: only proceed when the unsigned byte at this+0x117 is less than 8 (state threshold); when it is 8 or greater, no modification occurs.
*(this+0x60) |= 4u: OR bit 4 into the flags DWORD at offset 0x60.
*(this+0x118) = 8: write the byte 8 into the state byte at offset 0x118.
Called by sub_50210E (0x0050210E) as a state-advancing helper that flags the object and promotes its state byte to 8.

unresolved: Meaning of the 8-valued state threshold at 0x117, the bit-4 flag at 0x60, and the state byte value 8 at 0x118 depends on the enclosing driver/object state machine, whose definition is not in this function.
